description: This file contains the implementation of the DynamoDBGrainStorage class, a storage provider for Orleans that persists grain state in DynamoDB, supporting JSON or binary formats. It includes methods for initializing the storage table, reading, writing, and clearing grain state, and handles DynamoDB interactions and serialization.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorage
classes.description: Implements Orleans IGrainStorage interface to store grain state in DynamoDB; manages initialization, reading, writing, and clearing of grain data with DynamoDB interactions.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage to the silo lifecycle at a specified stage.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the DynamoDB table and storage settings asynchronously.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Completes any shutdown procedures for the storage provider.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads grain state data from DynamoDB and populates the grain state object.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Persists grain state data into DynamoDB, updating or inserting as necessary.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or deletes the grain state from DynamoDB depending on configuration.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes stored byte array into grain state object.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state object into byte array for storage.

methods.name: ResetGrainState
methods.description: Resets the grain state to default instance.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of grain state object using the activator provider.

methods.name: GetKeyString
methods.description: Constructs a DynamoDB partition key string for a grain ID.
